action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Apache Commons Configuration enabled the script,
dns, and url interpolation lookups by default. If an application used the
default interpolation settings with untrusted configuration values, an
attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code or cause
the application to contact remote servers. This update removes these
lookups from the default set.
isummary:
Apache Commons Configuration could be made to run programs if it received
specially crafted input.

commons-configuration2.description: Java based library providing a generic configuration interface

title: Apache Commons Configuration vulnerability
